note: Ordering is approximate. GitHub's report does not timestamp every causal step, so events are arranged to read as a narrative, not as a precise second-by-second log. Every 'observed' line is drawn only from GitHub's incident report or status page.

events.observed: GitHub.com begins serving elevated errors and latency across Issues, Pull Requests, APIs, Actions, and Copilot.
Web and API error rates reach ~20%. Archive and raw file downloads reach ~50%.
GitHub's stated immediate cause: network saturation on load balancers in the Central US datacenter, following a new peak in traffic.
GitHub names the origin: an Istio sidecar pod reached its concurrency limits.
The sidecar failed to autoscale correctly: a misconfigured policy watched the host service, not the sidecar's own limits.
Optimistic retry logic overloaded internal load balancers, worsening the failure.
The failure cascaded until four HAProxy nodes exhausted their flow limits, degrading the gateway authentication path and causing widespread authentication latency and failures.
SAML/OIDC authentication, SCIM, and Team Sync are affected, alongside the other product surfaces.
Some failing traffic is moved from Central US to Northern Virginia, where it is served successfully until the Central US network failure is resolved.
Delayed replies from one internal endpoint trigger a latent retry bug in VS Code, amplifying traffic ~10x. Copilot Token Service goes from a normal ~7-9K RPS to ~70-100K RPS.
Most services recover as the Central US datacenter recovers.
Actions remains degraded until about 18:03 UTC.
Pausing HAProxy on the affected nodes simultaneously produces immediate broad recovery.
The Northern VA retry storm is resolved by reducing gateway retry logic (a PR) and blocking Copilot Token Service requests at the load balancers with a 403, then ramping traffic back up per-site.
Scraping attacks on codeload endpoints complicate the recovery.
Copilot Token Service fully recovers at about 21:02 UTC, hours after everything else.
The incident is marked resolved. Total duration 7h47m.
